pages.title: Quarterly revenue
pages.text:
Q3 REVENUE REVIEW

Finance is assessing the timing of revenue booked near the quarter end. A group of shipments left the facility in October but was included in September totals. The team will reconcile the entries before the next reporting cycle.

pages.title: Facilities update
pages.text:
FACILITIES UPDATE

The east loading area is scheduled for maintenance next week. Please use the west entrance during the work. The staff kitchen will remain open. This notice does not address revenue recognition or the quarterly accounts.

pages.title: Committee minutes
pages.text:
AUDIT COMMITTEE — REVENUE TIMING

The committee requested an analysis comparing the quarterly figures under two possible cutoff dates. Finance will prepare a reconciliation of the affected shipments. The committee deferred its decision pending those figures.
